description:
Deliver the agent-friendly orchestration improvements identified through source review and dogfood feedback. This epic builds on the completed in-process orchestration cutover; it does not replace its lifecycle contracts.

## Outcomes

- `spawn` and `orchestrate` use one canonical `agent` selector backed by the same discovery system.
- Bundled lowest-precedence `worker` and `investigate` agents work without user setup and remain overridable by user/project definitions.
- Registration, liveness, rejection, and task completion are represented truthfully in tools, tree state, and TUI rendering.
- Human operators get a persistent compact fleet view; the parent model gets meaningful snapshots and an explicit group-idle continuation without polling or periodic progress wakes.
- General orchestration guidance clearly separates cooperative sidecar work from Beadwork's manager-only run mode.
- Beadwork shared-checkout tasks require atomic ticket-scoped commits and commit-SHA handoffs for independent review.

## Delivery order and concurrency contract

The first child is the schema/terminology cutover and MUST land first. It is the only initial ready child. Registration/rendering follows it. Later dependencies are arranged so every issue returned by `bw ready` is safe to assign concurrently; shared `index.ts`, tree, packet, and TUI integration work is serialized where necessary.

## Locked decisions

- Canonical selector is `agent`; `taskType` remains the separate closed workflow-policy field.
- Built-in defaults are lowest precedence: project definitions override user definitions, which override built-ins.
- Registration is not liveness. Child settlement remains fully idle and is evidence, not acceptance.
- Runtime-derived activity may be internally structured; child terminal output remains opaque prose.
- Use `setWidget()` for persistent fleet visibility. Keep `/minions` as drill-down. Do not replace the footer or use a focus-stealing overlay.
- No periodic model-visible progress messages. Real lifecycle packets remain the only wake path.
- Prompt guidance is the first boundary for sidecar vs manager-only behavior. Do not add an operating-mode field in this epic.
- `domain` remains opaque; never infer behavior from `domain.source`.

## Do not implement

- Structured child terminal-result schemas.
- `await_group`, polling, synchronous orchestration barriers, or periodic progress wakes.
- Commit detection/attribution heuristics in the shared checkout.
- A group `operatingMode` field, file locks, enforced path reservations, or parent edit interception.
- Beadwork imports of minions `AgentTree` or private runtime state.
- Child-owned Beadwork mutation; start/close decisions remain parent-owned.

## Quality and acceptance

Every implementation child includes focused regression coverage. Final acceptance requires package and workspace lint, tests, typecheck, build, deterministic cross-package orchestration coverage, and a manual TUI smoke for the persistent fleet surface. Source recommendation: `docs/proposals/agent-friendly-improvements-reco.md`; issues are self-contained and that document is not required during implementation.
title: Make pi-minions agent-friendly, truthful, and observable
